Last reviewed: **2026-10-26**. Evidence catalogue, not a list of universally supported TVs. Current platform is reported installed OS, not inferred model year.

**Only the Q74T entry is validated in TizenHalo.** Working upstream reports are evidence for an adapter, not a TizenHalo support promise.

Unknown firmware is shown explicitly. Open PRs are pinned separately from their parent project's default branch.

## Device notes

<a id="q74t"></a>
### QE55Q74T

- Firmware: `T-NKMDEUC-2743.0`. Evidence: `local_device`; checked 2026-10-26.
- Observation: Local firmware analysis and on-device video capture tests.
- Rate: About 14–15 full captures/s sustained; bursts do not remove the observed 150-response/~10 s budget.
- Limits: Applies to this firmware; do not extend its ABI or rate limit to every 5.5 TV.
- Sources: [halo-reference](https://github.com/tenda96/TizenHalo/blob/8e4f9107bf05c444dedff5852cd806b5d633bab3/README.md), [report 1](https://github.com/tenda96/TizenHalo/blob/8e4f9107bf05c444dedff5852cd806b5d633bab3/docs/TECHNICAL.md).

<a id="ru7100"></a>
### UN43RU7100FXZC

- Firmware: `T-MSLAKUC-1500.5`. Evidence: `research`; checked 2026-10-26.
- Observation: Official firmware identified, encrypted header audit completed; owner has not tested the app.
- Rate: No capture measurement.
- Limits: 21 public key candidates failed; no recovered capture ABI. Main TizenHalo package still targets 5.5.
- Sources: [halo-reference](https://github.com/tenda96/TizenHalo/blob/8e4f9107bf05c444dedff5852cd806b5d633bab3/README.md), [report 1](https://www.samsung.com/ca/support/model/UN43RU7100FXZC/).

<a id="s84f"></a>
### QN77S84FAEXZA

- Firmware: `not supplied`. Evidence: `upstream_author`; checked 2026-10-26.
- Observation: TizenAmbilight reference TV; video plane for available video, RGB fallback for withheld frames.
- Rate: Upstream reports roughly 20–25 full captures/s; 24-point RGB set about 3.3–4.1 refreshes/s; LED sends are separate.
- Limits: Full-frame header differs from Q74T; complete RGB discovery alone does not validate TizenHalo on this model.
- Sources: [ambilight](https://github.com/RitwickVerma/TizenAmbilight/blob/ccb646600286a02150aa353db261ca3753a44a9e/README.md).

<a id="q80a"></a>
### QE55Q80AATXXC

- Firmware: `not supplied`. Evidence: `upstream_author`; checked 2026-10-26.
- Observation: Open PR reports rc=0, /frame.bmp with TV picture and FlatBuffers delivery to HyperHDR.
- Rate: No quantified capture FPS.
- Limits: Caller-owned Y/UV buffers and padded 256-byte header. Exact firmware, return geometry/stride contract, long-run and protected-video behavior are unverified. PR body uses the model name as a firmware label.
- Sources: [q80a-pr](https://github.com/lowryn/HyperTizen/pull/2).

<a id="qn90a"></a>
### GQ55QN90AATXZG

- Firmware: `T-NKM2DEUC-2310.0`. Evidence: `upstream_user`; checked 2026-10-26.
- Observation: Retargeted package starts, capture rc=-95; libtzcapturec access denied.
- Rate: No working capture measured.
- Limits: Follow-up explicitly confirms Partner distributor certificate was already in use. Signing alone did not fix this report.
- Sources: [ambilight](https://github.com/RitwickVerma/TizenAmbilight/blob/ccb646600286a02150aa353db261ca3753a44a9e/README.md), [report 1](https://github.com/RitwickVerma/TizenAmbilight/issues/2), [report 2](https://github.com/RitwickVerma/TizenAmbilight/issues/2#issuecomment-6396580499).

<a id="q7f-cert"></a>
### QN55Q7FAAFXZC

- Firmware: `T-RSLFAKUC-0090-1300.9`. Evidence: `upstream_user`; checked 2026-10-26.
- Observation: User says changing certificate type to Partner resolved the reported issue.
- Rate: Not supplied.
- Limits: No raw frame/rate result supplied in that resolution; do not treat as measured full compatibility.
- Sources: [ambilight](https://github.com/RitwickVerma/TizenAmbilight/blob/ccb646600286a02150aa353db261ca3753a44a9e/README.md), [report 1](https://github.com/RitwickVerma/TizenAmbilight/issues/1), [report 2](https://github.com/RitwickVerma/TizenAmbilight/issues/1#issuecomment-6357686799).

- Firmware: `not supplied`. Evidence: `upstream_user`; checked 2026-10-26.

<a id="r95h"></a>
### MRA65R95HAWXXY

- Firmware: `not supplied`. Evidence: `upstream_author`; checked 2026-10-26.
- Observation: Open PR author reports valid 10-bit pixels and end-to-end HyperHDR 22 to Hue Entertainment.
- Rate: 2 slots, 16×16 blocks, reported 20 ms settle; no measured full-set rate.
- Limits: Point measurements, not full frames; PR unmerged when checked. TizenHalo not tested on this TV.
- Sources: [r95h-pr](https://github.com/reisxd/HyperTizen/pull/14).

<a id="frame"></a>
### The Frame / platform identifier 24_PTM_FTV_T09

- Firmware: `TIZEN-TRUNK2025-PontusM-OSU-2024-HOTFIX-RELEASE_20260514.4`. Evidence: `upstream_author`; checked 2026-10-26.
- Observation: Open PR reports end-to-end Hyperion 2.2.1 to Hue.
- Rate: 2 slots, 16×16 blocks, 20 ms settle. ~25 Hz send-loop throttle is not measured point refresh.
- Limits: Consumer SKU not supplied. Autostart claim was retracted after boot testing; PR unmerged when checked.
- Sources: [frame-pr](https://github.com/reisxd/HyperTizen/pull/15).

<a id="qn90c"></a>
### QE55QN90CATXXU

- Firmware: `not supplied`. Evidence: `upstream_author`; checked 2026-10-26.
- Observation: lowryn README reports working RGB fallback; video-capture library absent.
- Rate: Author reports about 9 complete 8-point sets/s; HyperHDR 50 Hz smoothing is output.
- Limits: Current OS may be an upgrade. Export prefix not established by the model report; do not select by model year.
- Sources: [lowryn](https://github.com/lowryn/HyperTizen/blob/2a05e073608ee5413ae6302ee389b756e0b42c67/README.md).

<a id="qn90d"></a>
### Samsung QN90D (exact SKU not supplied)

- Firmware: `not supplied`. Evidence: `upstream_author`; checked 2026-10-26.
- Observation: Project README explicitly lists this model as confirmed working.
- Rate: Implementation defaults: 20 points, 2 slots, 20 ms per batch (~5 complete sets/s before overhead); not a per-model measurement.
- Limits: Uses custom UDP/ESP32 firmware rather than stock WLED. TizenHalo reuses only the RGB interface concept; no device test yet.
- Sources: [exzos](https://github.com/exzos28/tizen-os-ambilight/blob/c8ce69c5ae1aa2af914f48dff2a0a1ee238d090a/README.md).

<a id="q60d"></a>
### Samsung Q60D (exact SKU not supplied)

- Firmware: `not supplied`. Evidence: `upstream_author`; checked 2026-10-26.
- Observation: Project README explicitly lists this model as confirmed working.
- Rate: Implementation defaults: 20 points, 2 slots, 20 ms per batch (~5 complete sets/s before overhead); not a per-model measurement.
- Limits: Uses custom UDP/ESP32 firmware rather than stock WLED. TizenHalo reuses only the RGB interface concept; no device test yet.
- Sources: [exzos](https://github.com/exzos28/tizen-os-ambilight/blob/c8ce69c5ae1aa2af914f48dff2a0a1ee238d090a/README.md).

<a id="s95f"></a>
### QE77S95FATXXH

- Firmware: `1296.8`. Evidence: `upstream_author`; checked 2026-10-26.
- Observation: BigSant research reports UI mirroring, Plex video black; native capture denied. Current package is control-only.
- Rate: UI-only 320×180 about 25–30 fps; PC FFmpeg bridge about 23.94–23.97 fps, neither proves TV-native protected-video capture.
- Limits: Experimental RM/encoder attempts wedged hardware and needed power cycle. Do not implement these as production fallbacks. External PC bridge is a separate architecture.
- Sources: [bigsant](https://github.com/BigSant/HyperTizen/blob/e6b4acea23bd4fd53a779ac23f371db70a55eda1/README.md).

<a id="qn75q7f-wled"></a>
### QN75Q7FAAGCZB

- Firmware: `not supplied`. Evidence: `upstream_author`; checked 2026-10-26.
- Observation: Author reports Netflix, YouTube and TV with WLED on this exact setup.
- Rate: About 5–6 complete 8-point sets/s measured; ~30 Hz interpolated sends are output. 4-point mode unmeasured.
- Limits: 40 addressable RGB pixels from 120 grouped physical LEDs. No universal support claim; TizenHalo RGB not tested here.
- Sources: [wled](https://github.com/matitoud/HyperTizen-WLED/blob/920673b1728b494d7698cc631ef6db1e42643298/README.md).

## Update procedure

1. Read source and follow-up comments; record the exact model, installed OS, firmware and tested source when supplied.
2. Edit `compatibility/catalogue.json`, pin implementation commits and keep missing data explicit.
3. Keep full-frame capture, complete point-set refresh and interpolated LED send rate separate.
4. Run `python3 tools/compatibility-catalogue.py`, then `python3 tools/compatibility-catalogue.py --check`.
5. Update the portability log/handoff. Promote TizenHalo support only with a recorded owner test.

See [the plan](PORTABILITY-PLAN.md), [native contracts](CAPTURE-CONTRACTS.md) and [handoff](PORTABILITY-HANDOFF.md).
